title: Neerparavai
desc: A fisherman's widow visits the beach every day, hoping that her husband might return, despite being aware of his death and the weird looks from her community.

title: Uyarntha Ullam
desc: Anand, a drunkard, gets into a brawl and is saved by Selvam, whom he appoints as his personal assistant. Later, he falls in love with Geetha and decides to transform his lifestyle.

title: Deiva Vaakku
desc: Hamsaveni's divine power earns her respect among the villagers, whereas her brother, Vallatharai, tries to exploit her power for his personal gain. He goes to the extent of sabotaging her marriage.

title: Sudesi
desc: Sudesi stumbles upon a plot involving a corrupt state CM and his right-hand man through a CD containing incriminating evidence. He decides to use the opportunity for the good of the people.

title: Manaivi Ready
desc: Radha, a young man, visits a village to attend the wedding of his friend's sister. However, when the groom runs away, he is forced to marry the devastated bride.

title: Pesadha Kannum Pesume
desc: Vikram, a habitual prankster, decides to play a prank on his lover, Swetha, by telling her he is already married. However, his plan backfires on him when Swetha's marriage gets fixed with another man.

title: Piragu
desc: Sathya, an aspiring film director, moves to Chennai to pursue his dream. However, his life takes a complicated turn when he is targeted by two rival gangs.

title: Fillers
desc: A comprehensive compilation of promotional videos and trailers of Bollywood movies featuring popular actors and actresses.

title: Andha 7 Naatkal
desc: When Vasanthi's husband, Dr Anand, learns that she was forcefully married to him, he decides to reunite her with her lover. However, Vasanthi soon falls for him and accepts him as her husband.

title: Neethiyin Marupakkam
desc: A carefree young man pays a heavy price for falling in love with a landlord's daughter after unknown assailants kill his family. Eventually, he decides to confront the landlord and seek his revenge.
